نعلول (form XII)
# نَعْلَوْلِ (naʕlawli) /naʕ.law.li/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# نُعْلَوْلَ (nuʕlawla) /nuʕ.law.la/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
